pmu.policy: Median of three process medians of raw user-only kernel counts. No multiplex scaling. Caller/main TID only; control edges included; setup, warmups, encoding and exact checks excluded. Speed changes optimization and register allocation together.

helper_entry_counts.policy: Same-driver authenticated hardware entry counters with fresh controls for the 2255 baseline and current candidate. Target populations overlap; report each target separately and do not sum them into source entries, calls, allocations or extents.

historical.scope: Archived 5aa compiler leaf sampling only; not refreshed or relabelled for the current compiler.

current.limits: Period-weighted user cycle samples, not exact calls, wall time, allocations, or speedup. Own leaf owners are disjoint; inclusive owners and helper caller rows overlap. Unresolved host symbols and unavailable callchains remain explicit and in the own-period denominator.

limits: Counters and entry instrumentation perturb execution; profiled timings are not scored.
Per-target instrumentation overlaps; these counts do not identify allocation origins or causal removable time.
No fresh old-compiler PMU cohort is claimed; Fast/Speed/V8 PMU data all come from the final diagnostic campaign.
Fresh FP locations are period-weighted cycle samples, not exact calls, allocations, wall-time shares or speedup evidence. Physical allocation has not been recounted.
